input.quote: Provisions that should reasonably be considered to survive termination of the Agreement will survive and be enforceable after such termination or expiration, including without limitation provisions relating to confidentiality, proprietary rights, indemnification, limitations of liability, effects of termination, and governing Law.
input.rationale:
Compliant at the preferred position: the Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or other restrictive covenant binding Customer, and the preferred position for NOSOLICIT is precisely the absence of any non-solicit on Customer.

Evidence of absence: the document is a single flat section, so there is no separate restrictive-covenants or general-provisions section in which a covenant could sit. Searches for the rule's detection triggers "solicit", "induce" and "recruit" return zero hits. The residual "hire"/"employ"/"personnel" matches are all unrelated: "hired by, employed, retained or under ... control" appears only in the mutual indemnities (p0051, p0052); "employees" appears only in the consequential-damages exclusion (p0027), the indemnity beneficiary lists (p0047, p0052) and the confidentiality permitted-disclosure carve-out (p0061); "personnel" appears only in the data-security access-control covenants (p0035, p0045). The miscellaneous provisions run from (a) to (i) with no gap in lettering (p0064-p0073) before the signature block at p0074, ruling out an omitted subsection. The independent contractor clause (p0066) disclaims an employment relationship but imposes no hiring or solicitation restriction, so it creates no implied covenant. The quoted survival list at p0070 enumerates confidentiality, proprietary rights, indemnification, limitations of liability, effects of termination and governing law, and omits any non-solicit, confirming none exists to survive.

The deterministic checks for duration (12 months or less) and for a general-solicitation carve-out are inapplicable, and their failure is not evidence of an error: both measure the wording of an existing non-solicit, and there is none in this Agreement to measure. No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, because the absence of a covenant benefits our party and flagging it would invite Kubient to add a restriction the Associated Press does not currently carry.

Noted for the negotiation file only, not as a deviation: if Kubient later proposes a non-solicit, our fallback ceiling is a mutual covenant limited to personnel directly involved in the services, running 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire.
